title: Late arrival — two legal, in-policy paths; only judgment picks the right one
note: Not act/escalate/stop. Both options are agent_may && legal && non-money && non-access. Proves tier-2 discretion (option choice + reply) is real, not decorative — the gate must treat both identically.

packet.reason: Guest explicitly asked for someone to meet them, not just a code. Both A and B are in policy; B matches the stated need.

guest_message.text: We'll land close to 22:30. My mother is traveling with me and doesn't do well with lockboxes or dark stairs at night — could someone actually be there to let us in?

context_on_file: Stay version 1, 2 guests on the booking
House rules: self-check-in via lockbox is standard after 21:00; host on-call for assisted check-in on request

options.summary: Standard self-check-in: send lockbox code and directions
options.guest_reply: No problem — for arrivals after 21:00 it's self check-in. I'll send the lockbox code and directions closer to your arrival.

options.summary: Assisted check-in: host on-call meets guest at the door
options.guest_reply: Got it — I'll have the host on-call meet you both at the door around 22:30 so no one has to deal with the lockbox in the dark. I'll text you their name once it's confirmed.

commitments: Assisted check-in requested for late arrival, mother traveling
